1164-2173-4740-6333.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-2173-4740-6333.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Hades, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-2173-4740-6333.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

323-2527-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.

323-2527-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

There is a land on the battlefield.

1371-3432-4522-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1371-3432-4522-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling the damage sources you control deal this turn.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 40 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Quest for Pure Flame.
Repeat from step 5 for each remaining Star of Extinction until each opponent loses the game.
1371-3432-4522-6500.notes: If an opponent survives the loop, you will lose the game if you have 80 or less life once your own Star of Extinction resolves.

Repeat.
56-789-1417-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

168-526-851-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.
